grammar.title: Simply, virtually with 简直
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 简直 + 形容词/动词短语
grammar.explanation: 简直 (jiǎnzhí) means "simply, virtually, practically" — used for exaggeration, showing something is almost too much to believe. It goes right before the adjective or verb it emphasizes, often with 了 at the end.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi jiǎnzhí tài hǎo le!
sentences.en: This news is simply too good!
This place is simply extremely beautiful.
